entities.summary: Petr Altrichter (b. 1951-05-24, Frenštát pod Radhoštěm) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Frenštát pod Radhoštěm and Czech Republic. Known in the fields of czech republic, composers & musicians, europe.
